server.title: Something went wrong on our side
server.body: This isn’t your fault. Please try again in a moment. Your coins, unlocked episodes and library are safe.
server.still: Still not working. We’ve been notified and are on it. Try again in a minute.

offline.title: You’re offline
offline.body: Check your Wi-Fi or mobile data. We’ll reconnect as soon as you’re back online.
offline.still: Still offline. Check your connection and try again.
offline.ok: You’re back online. Taking you back…
tips: Turn Wi-Fi or mobile data off and on again
Move closer to your router, or try another network

maintenance.title: PhumiReader is getting an update
maintenance.body: We’re making reading faster. We’ll be back soon, and your coins, unlocked episodes and library are safe.
maintenance.notifyToast: We’ll notify you when PhumiReader is back.
